active_goal_objective: 이런식으로 일단 49데이터에서 조금 높은거 이유 분석하고 계속 고쳐줘 그래서 제일 높은게  5cm 이하 가 될때까지 계속 분석해서 고치고 쭉 해줘

phase1.population: original nonsevere TEST49, with CAL46 as calibration population
phase1.required_completion: all original49 included, sealed same centroid metric, maximum translation_cm <= 5

phase2.scope: remaining available pose data in the existing workspace, using verified manifests and identity/provenance
phase2.first_action: freeze the completed phase1 method, sources, models and calibration before remainder inference
phase2.workflow: apply the method, seal predictions, evaluate available pose references, inspect large errors and continue the requested analysis and corrections

persisted_user_constraints.S_keypoints: model projection from PnP only; no local measurement or exact point prediction
persisted_user_constraints.U_keypoints: uncertainty region only; no precise image-corner search

inventory_requirements: keep original CAL46 and TEST49 identities separate from new evaluation rows
verify RGB SHA256 overlap and duplicate aliases
distinguish physical FINAL from legacy FINAL_EVAL alias
check RGB, camera intrinsics, known physical dimensions and pose-reference availability
record unknown severity and unreviewed raw captures separately rather than treating them as clean
separate pose-positive data from negative images with no pallet pose
